record.NAME: k_lcda_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the LCDA feature when the k_lcda_enable_via_cal is also set to TRUE.

record.NAME: k_lcda_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Used to decide whether LCDA should be enabled based on the calibration. TRUE=>k_lcda_enable is used to enable LCDA, FALSE=>lcdaEnabled flag from the core input is used to enable LCDA.

record.NAME: k_bsw_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of holding cycles for BSW alert.

record.NAME: k_cvw_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of holding cycles for CVW alert.

record.NAME: k_elc_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of holding cycles for ELC alert.

record.NAME: k_slc_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of holding cycles for SLC alert.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_exist_prop
record.DESCRIPTION: Min existence probability for tracks

record.NAME: k_lcda_host_activation_speed_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal host speed for which LCDA shall be active.

record.NAME: k_lcda_host_activation_speed_min_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for k_lcda_host_activation_speed_min_min. This value will be subtracted from minimal activation speed threshold if LCDA is currently active.

record.NAME: k_lcda_host_activation_speed_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximal host speed for which LCDA shall be active.

record.NAME: k_lcda_host_activation_speed_max_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for k_lcda_host_activation_speed_min_max. This value will be added to maximal activation speed threshold if LCDA is currently active.

record.NAME: k_lcda_turn_signal_coast_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of scans to hold turn signal after it is cancelled by the driver.

record.NAME: k_lcda_distance_traveled_scale_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: Inhibits the amount by which the CVW zone length restores after it was shortened. The restoration (travelled distance of ego) is multiplied by this value.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_curve_radius
record.DESCRIPTION: LCDA is disabled when the host is navigating a curve with a radius smaller than this value.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_curve_radius_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis value to be applied before LCDA is disabled for small curve radius.

record.NAME: k_lcda_f_disable_due_to_small_curve_radius
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether entire LCDA functionality should be disabled when the host is moving with a very small curve radius such as a round about.

record.NAME: k_lcda_curve_radius_threshold_for_zone_adaptation
record.DESCRIPTION: If the curve radius is below this value, the cvw zone shortening is applied.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_lane_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum lane width - used for plausibility checking during zone creation. If input lane width is lower than this, this value width is used.

record.NAME: k_lcda_max_lane_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum lane width - used for plausibility checking during zone creation. If input lane width is larger than this, this max lane width is used.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_ego_vehicle_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum ego width - used for plausibility checking during zone creation. If input ego width is lower than this, this min value is used.

record.NAME: k_lcda_max_ego_vehicle_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum ego width - used for plausibility checking during zone creation. If input ego width is larger than this, this max value is used.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_ego_vehicle_length
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum ego length - used for plausibility checking during zone creation. If input ego length is lower than this, this min value is used.

record.NAME: k_lcda_max_ego_vehicle_length
record.DESCRIPTION: >Maximum ego length - used for plausibility checking during zone creation. If input ego length is larger than this, this max value is used.

record.NAME: k_lcda_zone_check_method
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the method for checking the object zone occupation. 0: Checks zone overlap, 1: Only check reference point.

record.NAME: k_lcda_zone_intersect_critical_point_lateral_ratio
record.DESCRIPTION: Determines which point is checked for objects heading towards the zone if CRITICAL_POINT_IN_ZONE is used as intersect detection. 0.0=lateral center of object, 1.0=lateral inner edge.

record.NAME: k_lcda_allow_track_status_new
record.DESCRIPTION: Allow using the tracks with TRACK_STATUS_NEW in the valid BSW/CVW candidate selection. When it is FALSE, only the mature and coasted tracks are considered for candidate selection.

record.NAME: k_lcda_exist_prob_lc_intention_hys_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset for the existence probability of an alerting object when a lane change intention is given. This offset will be subtracted from the minimum needed existence probability k_lcda_min_exist_prop.

record.NAME: k_lcda_lc_intention_guardrail_min_lat_pos_to_use_small_zone
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimal lateral position of a radar guardrail to use the smaller lane change intention cvw zone.

record.NAME: k_lcda_f_lc_intention_use_small_zone_if_no_guardrail_present
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag indicating if the smaller lane change intention cvw zone should be used if no radar guardrail is present.

record.NAME: k_lcda_lc_intention_cycles_for_zone_change_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of cycles before the lane change intention zone is changed depending on changed guardrail information.

record.NAME: k_lcda_exist_prob_hys_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset for the existence probability for an object which gave an alert for an arbitrary submodule. This offset will be subtracted from the minimum needed existence probability k_lcda_min_exist_prop.

record.NAME: k_lcda_f_enable_obj_in_ego_lane_check
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable checking if an object is in the ego lane. When this is set to true, alerts from objects that are considered to be in the ego lane will be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_lcda_f_enable_suppress_alert_object_no_lane_change_intention
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable checking if an object will change lane based on relative lateral velocity. When this is set to true, alerts from objects that are in the ego lane and move towards ego center will be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_lcda_f_enable_suppress_alert_object_overhangs_zone_edge
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable checking if at least part of the object is outside the zone. When this is set to true, alerts from objects that protrudes beyond the boundaries of the zone will be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_lcda_lane_change_intention_vel_lat_thresh
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for relative velocity above which alert suppression functionality would be enabled.

record.NAME: k_bsw_lane_change_intention_vel_lat_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for relative velocity above which alert suppression functionality would be enabled.

record.NAME: k_bsw_f_enable_adv_pos_data_lane_change_intention
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables additional position verification for alert suppression in lane change intention algorithm.

record.NAME: k_bsw_lane_change_intention_pos_lat_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for lateral zone occupation above which alert won't be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_bsw_lane_change_intention_pos_long_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for longitudinal position below which alert won't be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_lcda_f_enable_alert_obj_in_ego_lane
record.DESCRIPTION: Enable alert when object is in ego lane and in BSW zone.

record.NAME: k_lcda_ego_lane_effective_lane_width_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: Lane width factor to be used when determining if a LCDA object is within the ego lane. Value should be between 0 and 1.

record.NAME: k_lcda_ego_lane_check_center_point_only
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the simple center point check to determine ego lane occupation. If disabled a more sophisticated polygon overlap is performed.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_exist_prob_lc_intention
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum existence probability threshold in case of lane change intention.

record.NAME: k_bsw_uses_cvw_alert_state_enabled
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables use of CVW alert state info in BSW 1) BSW hys zone is used directly 2) BSW mature count in zone is bypassed if there is a previous CVW alert on the object.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fallback_fast_to_slow_qual_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: Qualification counter threshold for a fallback transition from fast to slow.

record.NAME: k_bsw_zone_x
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining bsw zone in VCS coordinates.

record.NAME: k_bsw_zone_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining bsw zone in VCS coordinates.

record.NAME: k_bsw_zone_x_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset value that will be added to the initial BSW zone points x-coord to calculate the hysteresis zone x-coord values. Note hys zone is always larger than the initial zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_zone_y_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset value that will be added (or subtracted) to the initial BSW zone points y-coord to calculate the hysteresis zone y-coord values. Note hys zone is always larger than the initial zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_zone_y_hys_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Min value of the hysteresis [m] of the bsw, which is calculated via the object width.

record.NAME: k_bsw_zone_y_hys_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Max value of the hysteresis [m] of the bsw, which is calculated via the object width.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fixed_zone_x
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining bsw zone in VCS coordinates. Used for mode BSW_ZONE_CALC_FIXED_ZONE_VCS.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fixed_zone_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining bsw zone in VCS coordinates. Used for mode BSW_ZONE_CALC_FIXED_ZONE_VCS.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fixed_zone_x_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset value that will be added to the initial fixed BSW zone points x-coord to calculate the hysteresis zone x-coord values. Note hys zone is always larger than the initial zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fixed_zone_y_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset value that will be added to the initial fixed BSW zone points y-coord to calculate the hysteresis zone y-coord values. Note hys zone is always larger than the initial zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_lateral_distance_zone
record.DESCRIPTION: Distance between car and beginning of the BDS-Zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_overlap_area_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: Mimium area of target FOI, overlapped by BSW zone to raise BSW alert, expressed in percentage of FOI.

record.NAME: k_bsw_overlap_area_check_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables verification of target FOI area overlaped by BSW zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_use_curvi_coordinates
record.DESCRIPTION: When set to TRUE the BSW module will always use curvi coordinates for every check. Otherwise VCS coordinates will be used.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the BSW feature when the k_bsw_enable_via_cal is also set to TRUE.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Used to decide whether BSW should be enabled based on the calibration. TRUE=>k_bsw_enable is used to enable BSW, FALSE=>bswEnabled flag from the core input is used to enable BSW.

record.NAME: k_bsw_min_mature_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of mature cycles in zone as a valid bsw target before issuing an alert.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fallback_rel_vel_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: A target will be considered as slow back falling object if the relative velocity is above threshold.

record.NAME: k_bsw_fallback_rel_vel_thres_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: A target can be reclassified as fast back falling object if the relative velocity is below k_bsw_fallback_rel_vel_thres - k_bsw_fallback_rel_vel_thres_hys.

record.NAME: k_bsw_warntrigger_early
record.DESCRIPTION: Length factor of BSW zone in case the of HMI setting early warning, applies to points 3 and 4,Caution: CVW zone must overlap so that no gap occurs between CVW and BSW zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_warntrigger_late
record.DESCRIPTION: Length factor of BSW zone in case the of HMI setting late, applies to points 3 and 4, Caution: CVW zone must overlap so that no gap occurs between CVW and BSW zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_dynzone_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Dynamic BSW zone lookup table to increase the BSW zone based on the host vehicle speed (kph: [ 0 62.5 125 187.5 250 360]) Note: The point coordinates have to be sequenced in strict monotonic order.

record.NAME: k_bsw_dynzone_range
record.DESCRIPTION: Dynamic BSW zone lookup table to increase the BSW zone based on the host vehicle speed (kph: [ 0 62.5 125 187.5 250 360]) Note: The point coordinates have to be sequenced in strict monotonic order.

record.NAME: k_min_exist_prob_radar_guardrail
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum existence probability of a radar guardrail to determine, if an object is in conflict with its environment.

record.NAME: k_min_exist_prob_camera_guardrail
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum existence probability of a camera guardrail to determine, if an object is in conflict with its environment.

record.NAME: k_lcda_min_track_age
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum Track age for an object to be selected as a valid candidate for LCDA.

record.NAME: k_bsw_alert_track_age
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum Track age to trigger a warning immediately even though the object does not pass the mature in zone check.

record.NAME: k_bsw_dynzone_speed_dropback
record.DESCRIPTION: BSW look up table to shrink the dynamic warn zones during drop back = slow overtaking maneuvers based on relative speeds.

record.NAME: k_bsw_dynzone_speed_dropback_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum speed until the BSW look up table to shrink the dynamic warn zones is active.

record.NAME: k_bsw_dynzone_range_dropback
record.DESCRIPTION: BSW look up table to shrink the dynamic warn zones during drop back = slow overtaking maneuvers based on relative speeds.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable_zone_front_boundary_specific_conditions
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables alert behaviours different than typical for entering/leaving front zone boundary.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable_specific_front_sot_conditions
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables alert behaviours different than typical for entering front zone boundary.

record.NAME: k_bsw_n_line_position_for_long_object_sot_scenario
record.DESCRIPTION: In SOT scenario alert is active when the rear of long object reaches this line. Close to the position of rear host bumper (N line) in VCS coordinates (shall be negative)

record.NAME: k_bsw_stop_alert_reaching_front_custom_limit_mode
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the type of front custom boundary, that will stop alert, when reached by overtaking object. 0: BSW zone longitudinal max, 1: Host front bumper, 2: Custom line - k_bsw_line_to_stop_TOS_alert.

record.NAME: k_bsw_line_to_stop_TOS_alert
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the longitudinal line for front bsw zone boundary to disable alert for TOS case. Requires k_bsw_stop_alert_reaching_front_custom_limit_mode = 2

record.NAME: k_bsw_hold_alert_long_object
record.DESCRIPTION: Objects that are overtaking and are classified as long trucks would hold alert until whole object leave the zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_min_length_long_object
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum length of the object that will be classified as a long object.

record.NAME: k_bsw_min_length_long_object_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum length of the object that will be classified as a long object.

record.NAME: k_bsw_suppress_late_warning_max_time_till_leave
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum time until the object leaves the rear bsd zone border in which a BSD warning can be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_bsw_suppress_late_warning_min_pos_behind_host
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum object distance behind ego rear at which a BSD warning can be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_bsw_suppress_late_warning_max_rel_vel
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum relative velocity at which BSD warning can be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_bsw_max_heading_abs
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum allowed absolute heading for objects in the bsw zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_max_heading_abs_hysteresis
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis of the maximum allowed absolute heading for objects in the bsw zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_min_obj_long_vel
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum longitudinal velocity in vcs of an object for the bsw zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_max_obj_long_vel
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum longitudinal velocity in vcs of an object for the bsw zone.

record.NAME: k_bsw_min_obj_long_vel_hysteresis
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis of the minimum longitudinal velocity in vcs of an object for the bsw zone, that is added to k_bsw_min_obj_long_vel.

record.NAME: k_bsw_max_obj_long_vel_hysteresis
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis of the maximum longitudinal velocity in vcs of an object for the bsw zone, that is added to k_bsw_max_obj_long_vel.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable_factor_based_host_speed_adjustment
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables a host speed dependend bsw zone adjustment with the same factor for normal and hysteresis zone related to host rear. NOTE: Zone definitions must be handled very carefully when enabled!.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable_dynspeed_zone
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables dynamic BSW zone adaptation based on ego speed.

record.NAME: k_bsw_enable_trailer_zone_extension
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables an additional adjustment of the BSW zone based on trailer information in core input.

record.NAME: k_bsw_trailer_zone_min_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets minimal width of BSW zone if k_bsw_enable_trailer_zone_extension is enabled.

record.NAME: k_bsw_f_zone_extension_by_diff_width_host_vs_trailer
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables adjustment lateral dimension of the BSW zone if the trailer is wider than the host, modify the size with this value.

record.NAME: k_bsw_f_enable_trailer_zone_adjustment_on_ego_side
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables modification of the BSW zone by shifting the boundary on the ego side based on trailer information in core input data.

record.NAME: k_bsw_f_enable_trailer_zone_adjustment_on_outer_side
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables modification of the BSW zone by shifting the boundary on the ego side based on trailer information in core input data.

record.NAME: k_bsw_trailer_zone_ext_safety_margin
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal extension of the rear edge of the bsw zone behind the trailer edge.

record.NAME: k_bsw_trailer_zone_ext_safety_margin_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for longitudinal extension of the rear edge of the bsw zone behind the trailer edge.

record.NAME: k_bsw_guardrail_distance_safety_margin
record.DESCRIPTION: This value will be added to the guardrail distance for calculations in BSW to prevent falsely filtered due to minor tracker inaccuracies.

record.NAME: k_cvw_zone_x
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining cvw zone in curvi coordinates.

record.NAME: k_cvw_zone_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining cvw zone in curvi coordinates. It is specified as a factor of the lane width.

record.NAME: k_cvw_zone_y_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset as a factor of the lane width that is to be added/subtracted from the initial CVW zone y-coord to get the hysteresis zone y-coord. Hys zone is always larger than the initial zone.

record.NAME: k_cvw_zone_y_hys_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Max value of the hysterese [m] of the cvw. Offset added to initial zone.

record.NAME: k_cvw_zone_y_hys_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Min value of the hysterese [m] of the cvw. Offset added to initial zone.

record.NAME: k_cvw_warntrigger_early
record.DESCRIPTION: TTC offset to k_cvw_ttc if k_lcda_warntrigger_hmi=4.

record.NAME: k_cvw_warntrigger_late
record.DESCRIPTION: TTC offset to k_cvw_ttc if k_lcda_warntrigger_hmi=0.

record.NAME: k_lcda_max_range
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum Range of a track that can trigger a warning.

record.NAME: k_cvw_gap_bridge
record.DESCRIPTION: Parameter describing the time between two alerts, when the Alert should not go off.

record.NAME: k_cvw_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the CVW feature when the k_cvw_enable_via_cal is also set to TRUE.

record.NAME: k_cvw_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Used to decide whether CVW should be enabled based on the calibration. TRUE=>k_cvw_enable is used to enable CVW, FALSE=>cvwEnabled flag from the core input is used to enable CVW.

record.NAME: k_cvw_candidate_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: If TTC of an object is lower than this threshold it is considered a candidate for a CVW alert.

record.NAME: k_cvw_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum TTC to issue an alert.

record.NAME: k_cvw_ttc_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Added to TTC threshold when an alert is active.

record.NAME: k_cvw_min_mature_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of mature cylces in zone as a valid cvw target before issuing an alert.

record.NAME: k_cvw_min_mature_cycles_lc_intention
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum number of mature cylces in lane change intention zone as a valid cvw target before issuing an alert

record.NAME: k_cvw_max_curvi_heading_abs
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum allowed absolute curvi heading for objects in the cvw zone.

record.NAME: k_cvw_min_obj_curvi_long_vel
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum longitudinal curvi velocity of an object for the cvw zone.

record.NAME: k_zone_hys_obj_width_correction
record.DESCRIPTION: Object with this width receive a zone hysteresis with factor 1, for smaller objects it is computed as object_width divided by k_zone_hys_obj_width_correction between 0 and 1.

record.NAME: k_cvw_curve_zone_factor_outer
record.DESCRIPTION: While driving, the length of the CVW zone is set to the circumference of the curvature of the ego multiplied by this factor. This leads to a shortening of the CVW zone on the outer side of the curve.

record.NAME: k_cvw_curve_zone_factor_inner
record.DESCRIPTION: While driving, the length of the CVW zone is set to the circumference of the curvature of the ego multiplied by this factor. This leads to a shortening of the CVW zone on the inner side of the curve.

record.NAME: k_enable_cvw_curve_zone_adaptation
record.DESCRIPTION: allows customers to enable and disable the curveZoneAdaptation function to cut the cvw zone in curve.

record.NAME: k_cvw_zone_calculation_mode
record.DESCRIPTION: Determines how the zone will be calculated. 0=DEFAULT, 1=Zone based on Vehicle Length and Lane Width, 2=Zone fixed to be taken from LCDA core input.

record.NAME: k_cvw_time_obj_start_decel_after_lane_change
record.DESCRIPTION: Time after lane change where tracked object starts to decelerate.

record.NAME: k_cvw_time_diff_after_obj_decel
record.DESCRIPTION: Time difference between host and object after deceleration of the object.

record.NAME: k_cvw_crit_dist_hys_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: In case that a previous cvw alert has been given, a multiplicative hysteresis factor is applied to the critical distance.

record.NAME: k_cvw_crit_dist_additive_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: In case that a previous cvw alert has been given, an additive hysteresis can be applied to the critical distance.

record.NAME: k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_x
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal coordinates of the corners of a polygon defining cvw zone in curvi coordinates in case of triggering a lane change intention. Depending on k_lcda_lc_intention_guardrail_min_lat_pos_to_use_small_zone and k_lcda_f_lc_intention_use_small_zone_if_no_guardrail_present different coordinates defined in k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_small_x might be used instead.

record.NAME: k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral coordinates of the corners of a polygon defining cvw zone in curvi coordinates in case of triggering a lane change intention. Depending on k_lcda_lc_intention_guardrail_min_lat_pos_to_use_small_zone and k_lcda_f_lc_intention_use_small_zone_if_no_guardrail_present different coordinates defined in k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_small_y might be used instead.

record.NAME: k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_small_x
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal coordinates of the corners of a polygon defining cvw zone in curvi coordinates in case of triggering a lane change intention. Depending on k_lcda_lc_intention_guardrail_min_lat_pos_to_use_small_zone and k_lcda_f_lc_intention_use_small_zone_if_no_guardrail_present different coordinates defined in k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_x might be used instead.

record.NAME: k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_small_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral coordinates of the corners of a polygon defining cvw zone in curvi coordinates in case of triggering a lane change intention. Depending on k_lcda_lc_intention_guardrail_min_lat_pos_to_use_small_zone and k_lcda_f_lc_intention_use_small_zone_if_no_guardrail_present different coordinates defined in k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_small_y might be used instead.

record.NAME: k_cvw_lane_change_intention_zone_hys_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset as a factor of the lane width that is to be added from the initial cvw lane change intention zone.

record.NAME: k_cvw_f_most_crit_obj_must_be_closest_relevant_obj
record.DESCRIPTION: Limits the CVW alert to the closest relevant CVW object. A critical object behind a relevant object will be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_cvw_y_width1
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral width of CVW zone (lat offset of p2 from p3 for right side zone).

record.NAME: k_cvw_x_length1
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal length of CVW zone (long offset of p2 from p1 with ref point at center of the ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_cvw_y1
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral start point p3 of right side CVW zone (ref point is center of the ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_cvw_x_length0
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal length of CVW zone (long offset of p1 from p0 with ref point at center of ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_cvw_y_width0
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral width of CVW zone (lat offset of p0 from p5 for right side zone).

record.NAME: k_cvw_y0
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral distance of start point p5 of right side CVW Zone (ref point is center of ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_cvw_x0
record.DESCRIPTION: The longitudinal distance of start point p0 of the CVW zone for right side (ref point is center of ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_bsw_y1_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: The absolute width of the upper lateral hysteresis of BSW zone on right side (offset to p0 of initial zone).

record.NAME: k_bsw_y0_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: The absolute width of the bottom lateral hysteresis of BSW zone on right side (offset to p3 of initial zone).

record.NAME: k_bsw_x1_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Absolute length of the bottom longitudinal hysteresis of BSW zone from initial zone (offset to p2 of initial zone).

record.NAME: k_bsw_x0_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Absolute length of upper longitudinal hysteresis of BSW zone from initial zone (offset to p0 of initial zone).

record.NAME: k_bsw_y_width
record.DESCRIPTION: The lateral width of the BSW zone (offset of p0 from p5 for right side zone).

record.NAME: k_bsw_y0
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral distance of start point p0 of BSW Zone for right side (ref point at center of ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_bsw_x_length
record.DESCRIPTION: The longitudinal length of the BSW zone (offset of p2 from p0 with ref point at center of the ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_bsw_x0
record.DESCRIPTION: The longitudinal distance of start point p0 of the BSW zone (ref point is center of the ego rear bumper).

record.NAME: k_lka_ov_zone_width
record.DESCRIPTION: LKA zone width.

record.NAME: k_slc_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the Sim Lane Change feature when the k_slc_enable_via_cal is also set to TRUE.

record.NAME: k_slc_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Used to decide whether Sim Lane Change should be enabled based on the calibration. TRUE=>k_slc_enable is used to enable SLC, FALSE=>slcEnabled flag from the core input is used to enable SLC.

record.NAME: k_slc_zone_x
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining Sim Lane Change zone in curvi coordinates.

record.NAME: k_slc_zone_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Corners of polygon defining the SLC zone in curvi coordinates. It is specified as a factor of the lane width.

record.NAME: k_slc_zone_y_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset as a factor of the lane width that is to be added/subtracted from the initial SLC zone y-coord to get the hysteresis zone y-coord. Hys zone is always larger than the initial zone.

record.NAME: k_slc_max_curvi_heading_abs
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum allowed absolute curvi heading for objects to be considered as valid Sim Lane Change candidates.

record.NAME: k_slc_min_obj_curvi_long_vel_abs
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum longitudinal absolute curvi velocity of the object to be considered as a valid candidate for Sim Lane Change.

record.NAME: k_slc_max_obj_eclipse
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum eclipse value of the object to be considered as a valid candidate for Sim Lane Change.

record.NAME: k_slc_critical_lat_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral TTC threshold below which a target is considered as critical for SLC.

record.NAME: k_slc_critical_lat_ttc_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Added to lateral TTC threshold when object is considered as critical for SLC.

record.NAME: k_slc_critical_lon_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal TTC threshold below which a target is considered as critical for SLC.

record.NAME: k_slc_critical_lon_ttc_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Added to longitudinal TTC threshold when object is considered as critical for SLC.

record.NAME: k_slc_lateral_ttc_lookup
record.DESCRIPTION: Look up table with the lateral TTC values to be used to find the corresponding lane change probability> Note that the values should be in strictly monotonic order.

record.NAME: k_slc_lane_change_prob_lookup
record.DESCRIPTION: Look up table with the lane change probability (to be used along with the lateral ttc lookup).

record.NAME: k_slc_warntrigger_TTC_lat_late
record.DESCRIPTION: TTC threshold adaption for lateral TTC warning in case the of HMI setting late warning.

record.NAME: k_slc_warntrigger_TTC_lat_early
record.DESCRIPTION: TTC threshold adaption for lateral TTC warning in case the of HMI setting early warning.

record.NAME: k_slc_warntrigger_TTC_lon_late
record.DESCRIPTION: TTC threshold adaption for longitudinal TTC warning in case the of HMI setting late warning.

record.NAME: k_slc_warntrigger_TTC_lon_early
record.DESCRIPTION: TTC threshold adaption for longitudinal TTC warning in case the of HMI setting early warning.

record.NAME: k_slc_obj_lc_effective_speed_min

record.NAME: k_slc_lookup_ego_speed

record.NAME: k_slc_lookup_ego_overlap_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: Look-up table for the ego speed dependent (see k_slc_lookup_ego_speed) ego overlap offset used to determine if an object is classified as besides the ego.

record.NAME: k_slc_min_mature_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: When the count in zone exceeds this threshold the object is allowed to create an SLC alert.

record.NAME: k_slc_alert_qualifying_counter
record.DESCRIPTION: When the qualifying counter is equal to or greater than this threshold the SLC alert won't be suppressed.

record.NAME: k_elc_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the Evasive Lane Change feature when the k_elc_enable_via_cal is also set to TRUE.

record.NAME: k_elc_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Used to decide whether Evasive Lane Change should be enabled based on the calibration. TRUE=>k_elc_enable is used to enable ELC, FALSE=>elcEnabled flag from the core input is used to enable ELC.

record.NAME: k_elc_zone_x

record.NAME: k_elc_max_curvi_heading_abs
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum allowed absolute curvi heading for objects to be considered as valid Evasive Lane Change candidates.

record.NAME: k_elc_min_obj_curvi_long_vel_abs

record.NAME: k_elc_obj_safe_deceleration_threshold_hys
